item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find strong public evidence of a voluntary asset-declaration release, campaign-finance disclosure, or any formal self-policing ethics mechanism that would independently demonstrate consistent moral leadership. The positive items are mostly rhetoric or reactive correction, while the negative items are more concrete: nepotistic appointment, misleading macro claims, patronage-prone distribution channels, press intimidation, and violent repression of dissent. One important counterweight is that Tinubu sometimes did use formal administrative channels against alleged abuse, but those cases were late and reactive rather than a standing ethical
